$comment: Written from crates/xenonet-model by cargo test -p xenonet-model. Change the type there, not this file.
title: Identity
description: An account work happens under: a Claude account in an organization, a ChatGPT workspace, an OpenAI API key, a GitHub account, or the email git commits with.

id.description: claude:<account>:<organization>, chatgpt:<workspace>, openai:api-key, github:<host>/<login> or git:<hash of the email>. Identities have no host: the ids are already global

handle.description: The email or login it shows as

org.description: A Claude team's or enterprise's name

active.description: gh's active account for its host

sources.description: Where XenoNet found it, with the home folder as ~

name.description: The name you gave it; identities with the same name show as one

hosts.description: With hosts on: the machines it was seen on, null for this one

signedInOn.description: With hosts on: the machines it's signed in on, null for this one
